title: "5. More Experiments, Easier Targets"

## **Why Multivariate Normal Distributions?**

[Explain why controlled distributions are useful.]

## **The Experimental Strategy**

We systematically vary:

- dimensionality,
- variance structure,
- correlation structure,
- anisotropy,
- coordinate representation.

The main quantities of interest are:

- warmup length,
- nested $\widehat{R}$,
- mean squared error.

## **1. Bivariate Normal Distributions**

### Varying Target Distribution Rotation

*Use this tool to visualize how the target distribution rotates.*

The following visualization shows the 68% and 95% probability regions of two bivariate normal distributions. 
We hypothesize that the ratio between the overlap volume of target-proposal distribution 
over the total volume of proposal distribution might contribute to how nested $\widehat{R}$ behaves across warmups.

## **What Are We Looking For?**

We are looking for the connection between MSE and $\widehat{R}_{\nu}$ across different distributions.


<script>
function setupImageSwitcher(buttonSelector, onSelect) {
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(buttonSelector);

  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      onSelect(btn);

      buttons.forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active');
        if (b.hasAttribute('aria-pressed')) {
          b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
        }
      });
      btn.classList.add('active');
      if (btn.hasAttribute('aria-pressed')) {
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      }
    });
  });

  // Mark the first button active on initial page load.
  if (buttons.length > 0) {
    buttons[0].classList.add('active');
  }
}

// 1. Bivariate covariance plots (combined MSE-Rhat and contour figure)
setupImageSwitcher('.cov-btn', btn => {
  const [var1, var2] = btn.dataset.config.split('-');
  const base =
    '../figures/chapter05/covariance_structure/bivariate/';

  const plot = document.getElementById('cov-plot');
  plot.src = `${base}${var1}_${var2}.png`;
  plot.alt =
    `MSE versus nested R-hat scatterplots and Gaussian contours for target variances ${var1} and ${var2}`;

  document.getElementById('covariance-title').textContent =
    `Target variances: ${var1} and ${var2}`;

  const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cov-btn'));
  const index = buttons.indexOf(btn);
  document.getElementById('covariance-status').textContent =
    `Configuration ${index + 1} of ${buttons.length}`;
});

// 2. Trivariate covariance plots
setupImageSwitcher('.tri-btn', btn => {
  const filename = btn.dataset.config.replace(/-/g, '_');
  const base =
    '../figures/chapter05/covariance_structure/trivariate/';

  document.getElementById('tri-plot').src =
    `${base}${filename}.png`;
});

// 3. 100-dimensional MVN highlight plots
setupImageSwitcher('.d100-btn', btn => {
  const base =
    '../figures/chapter05/covariance_structure/d100/';

  const filename = btn.dataset.image === 'noTransform'
    ? 'highlight_noTransform.png'
    : 'highlight_withTransform.png';

  document.getElementById('d100-plot').src =
    base + filename;
});
</script>
